entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. How can I help you today?
Yes, I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. I bought it a couple of weeks ago and it’s just not working out for me.
Okay, I can help you with a return for your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number, please?
Ugh, fine. It's #VF12345. Hurry this up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. Just a moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse placed on October 26th. Today is November 10th. So, you are within our return policy window.
Finally! Some good news. This thing is a piece of junk. How do I return it?

Our standard return policy allows you to return items within 90 days of purchase. I can initiate the return process for you right now. We'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address associated with the order.
90 days? Wow, that's pretty generous. Okay, great. Just send me the label.

Absolutely. You'll receive the label within the next hour. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, if possible, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process your refund. Please note that the VeloBand Pulse should be in good condition for a full refund.
Okay, original packaging…got it. What about smart watch accessories, can I return those within the same policy?
Yes, our standard return policy of 90 days applies to most items, including smart watch accessories. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, I think that's it. Thanks for your help. I was expecting a huge hassle, but that was surprisingly easy. I appreciate it.

You're very welcome! We are happy to help. Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit. I'm glad we could make the return process smooth for you. If you have any more questions about the VeloBand Pulse or any of our products, please don’t hesitate to call back. Have a good day.
